Package com.example.goboard.model

Class Intersection

java.lang.Object
com.example.goboard.model.Intersection
public class Intersection extends Object
Represents a single intersection (point) on the Go board. Responsibilities: - Stores row and column coordinates - Can hold a single stone (or be empty) - Can be marked as "dead" for scoring purposes Game rules (liberties, captures, etc.) are handled by the Board class.
